name: devault
description: Search and study real UI design references, analyze design patterns, and fetch ready-made design systems from the Devault library.

interface.longDescription:
Devault is a library of UI design references: screens from real websites and mobile apps, complete user flows, marketing emails, year-by-year redesigns and original interface concepts, each tagged by platform, industry, screen type and components.

With this plugin, ChatGPT and Codex can research that library while you work:
- Search screens by description, and narrow by platform, industry, screen type or company.
- Analyze a design pattern across the library: how common it is, where it appears and which components go with it.
- Have the assistant study a screen at a readable size and describe it, or find screens that look like one you picked. Every screen comes with a link that opens it on devault.design.
- Fetch a ready-made design system (palette, contrast grades, type scale, spacing) as DESIGN.md, Tailwind v4, CSS variables, shadcn/ui, design tokens, Figma variables, SwiftUI, Android XML or an image prompt.

It is for designers, developers and product teams who want a decision to rest on how shipped products look.

Good to know: the plugin only reads, and cannot change anything in your Devault account. Screens are references for study and inspiration; the companies shown are not affiliated with Devault. A search returns one page of results, and the number of images is limited per day. You need a Devault account whose plan includes MCP access.
defaultPrompt: Find onboarding screens from fintech apps
How do apps design paywalls? Show the numbers and a few examples
Get a dark dashboard design system as Tailwind tokens
